history_note: Phases 0, 1A, 1B, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unchanged and remain ACCEPTED_AND_CLOSED. T0044 through T0058 are unchanged. Phase 6 remains IN_PROGRESS, unaccepted and unmerged.

milestone.title: The AGGREGATE_ONLINE_TIME vertical slice, DARK
what_is_now_true: the mode is a property of the IMMUTABLE plan revision: an omitted mode is VALIDITY_WINDOW by default rather than by branch, a grant tier may not override it, and publication requires both the Phase-6 capability and a positive time budget

acquisition of a NEW aggregate entitlement is gated on every free path -- the PMS/stay grant and the Phase-2 free-commerce quote/confirm -- through ONE shared rule, with confirm re-checking above the consume step so a refusal consumes neither the quote nor the guest's auth context
accrual charges only sessions in state 'active', never PENDING_ENFORCEMENT, bounded by observation so unobserved time is recorded as skipped rather than charged
every session is billable only to the earliest of now, its own end, the immutable outer window and any terminal instant the sweep already knows -- including the DATA crossing
exhaustion is the exact piecewise crossing over the union of the billable intervals, because the burn rate changes whenever a contributor starts or ends
the sweep selects the EARLIEST terminal condition and its matching reason, so an entitlement that reached DATA before its window is ended as DATA at the DATA instant

the sanctioned expiry writer establishes the terminal condition from authoritative state and refuses a healthy entitlement; svc_acctd holds EXECUTE on that one operation, SELECT on the tables the sweep reads, and no write authority anywhere in iam_v2
accounting an entitlement that already exists is NOT gated on the deployment flag, so disabling the capability can never turn finite access unlimited; an empty aggregate set produces no writes
the guest sees both clocks -- remaining online time and the immutable hard expiry -- and the operator sees the same numbers from the same durable state

proofs.database_gates: phase6_0030_foundation 50/50, phase6_0031_device_self_service 22/22, phase6_0036_aggregate_online_time 49/49 (19 of them added for the window ceiling and the piecewise crossing, and proven to bite: 40/9 against the superseded implementation), phase6_least_privilege 54/54 measured as the real roles
proofs.sweep_integration: 24 EnforceExpiries proofs against real PostgreSQL: both DATA/TIME orderings, both both-elapsed orderings, the complete sweep run AS svc_acctd for a TIME exhaustion and a DATA termination, three refusals of healthy entitlements whose ids the role knows, three positive controls per condition, concurrency, restart, restore, rollback and a stranded exhaustion recovered with the accrual arm off
proofs.acquisition: CreateQuote/ConfirmFreePurchase against a real database with a pre-existing immutable aggregate revision: refused while OFF with zero quotes, purchases, entitlements and an unconsumed auth context; acquired normally while ON; VALIDITY_WINDOW identical either way; the revision unchanged throughout
proofs.presentation: hotel-admin 110/110 including the operator budget view, and portald template proofs that the guest panels stay hidden for every other package and expose no MAC or internal identity
proofs.regressions: edged Phase-3/4/5/6 API integration suites now RUN in this environment and are green -- the scratch platform fixture had stubbed public.operators without display_name, so they had been failing at fixture time rather than passing

corrections_made_during_m3: the outer window was not an accrual ceiling: a sweep after the window charged the stretch between them, and could report EXHAUSTION for an entitlement whose calendar had run out -- a false account produced from real data
the crossing instant assumed every contributor burned the same interval; it is now computed piecewise, which moves the answer by tens of seconds in ordinary staggered cases

the Phase-6 config was consumed by the commerce admin BEFORE it was loaded, pinning the publication capability off regardless of the environment -- invisible to every unit test, since the defect was the order of two statements
accrual was gated on the deployment flag, which would have turned an already-granted finite entitlement into unlimited access on any rollback; accrual is now data-driven
the expiry writer accepted a caller-supplied reason and instant, which was generic destructive termination authority under two labels
the candidate query preferred an elapsed window without comparing its instant to the DATA crossing

flag_state.phase6_flags: OFF everywhere, including every real environment. No Phase-6 flag has been enabled on any appliance.
flag_state.safe_disable: Publication, acquisition and the guest/operator surfaces are gated. Accounting of already-durable aggregate entitlements is not, and that asymmetry is deliberate: it is what prevents a disabled capability from silently granting unlimited access.
